mapper.sql: gifticon_product_id, name, brand_name, category, face_value_krw, required_points, status, image_url, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT p.gifticon_product_id, p.name, p.brand_name, p.category, p.face_value_krw, p.required_points, p.status, p.image_url, p.created_at, p.updated_at, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.status = 'AVAILABLE' AND c.expires_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS available_code_count, 0 AS assigned_code_count, 0 AS void_code_count FROM gifticon_products p LEFT JOIN gifticon_codes c ON c.gifticon_product_id = p.gifticon_product_id WHERE p.status = 'ON_SALE' AND p.category = #{category} AND p.gifticon_product_id > #{cursor} GROUP BY p.gifticon_product_id, p.name, p.brand_name, p.category, p.face_value_krw, p.required_points, p.status, p.image_url, p.created_at, p.updated_at ORDER BY p.gifticon_product_id LIMIT #{size}

SELECT p.gifticon_product_id, p.name, p.brand_name, p.category, p.face_value_krw, p.required_points, p.status, p.image_url, p.created_at, p.updated_at, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.status = 'AVAILABLE' AND c.expires_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS available_code_count, 0 AS assigned_code_count, 0 AS void_code_count FROM gifticon_products p LEFT JOIN gifticon_codes c ON c.gifticon_product_id = p.gifticon_product_id WHERE p.gifticon_product_id = #{gifticonProductId} AND p.status = 'ON_SALE' GROUP BY p.gifticon_product_id, p.name, p.brand_name, p.category, p.face_value_krw, p.required_points, p.status, p.image_url, p.created_at, p.updated_at
mapper.update: UPDATE gifticon_products SET name = #{name}, brand_name = #{brandName}, category = #{category}, face_value_krw = #{faceValueKrw}, required_points = #{requiredPoints}, status = #{status}, image_url = #{imageUrl,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE gifticon_product_id = #{gifticonProductId}
